business_summary: Wuhan Yifi Laser Corporation Limited researches, develops, designs, manufactures, and sells precision laser processing equipment and automated products. The company provides battery laser welding machines; battery cell manufacturing machines, such as cylindrical cell assembly machines and prismatic cell assembly machines; battery pack manufacturing machines, such as battery pack welding machines, battery sorting machines, battery stacking machines, and battery cleaning machines; battery component manufacturing machines; solar cell manufacturing machines; laser welding machines, such as precision laser welding machines and automatic laser welding machines; laser marking machines, including fiber laser marking machines; laser cleaning machines; and laser welding monitoring systems. It also offers battery assembly lines, battery pack assembly lines, battery recycling solutions, battery pilot lines, solar cell manufacturing lines, and intelligent logistics solutions. The company serves e-mobility batteries, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, intelligent logistics, household appliances, prefabricated construction, automotive components, and general hardware industries. Wuhan Yifi Laser Corporation Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Wuhan, China.
